subject.title: [Feature]: Persistent active-agent + workspace indicator in Dashboard (multi-agent safety)

question: Should persistent active-agent plus workspace context remain in the Dashboard breadcrumb/header, or should the newer header/topbar cleanup direction provide the same safety affordance somewhere else?
rationale: The source-backed gap remains, but the final UI placement overlaps with the focused closing PR and an open maintainer-labeled header cleanup PR.

options.title: Land focused workspace breadcrumb
options.body: Rebase and review the focused PR, then close this issue when persistent agent/workspace context lands and track optional switcher/prefix ideas separately.

options.title: Fold into header cleanup
options.body: Require the header cleanup direction to preserve an equivalent always-visible agent/workspace target before replacing the breadcrumb path.

options.title: Broaden the tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open for switch feedback, live-target proof, and optional quick-switch/message-prefix UX instead of closing on a focused breadcrumb.

recommendation.title: Land focused workspace breadcrumb
recommendation.body: Rebase and review the focused PR, then close this issue when persistent agent/workspace context lands and track optional switcher/prefix ideas separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Their open header/topbar PR is the current product-direction fork for whether breadcrumbs remain the persistent context surface.
